NVNM.name: Navmesh Geometry
NVNM.note: The mesh's geometry, laid out by measurement rather than by xEdit's definitions, which are conditional on the form version and leave the grid's shape to the reader. [measured: all 7,894 navigation meshes in Fallout4.esm fit this layout exactly, byte for byte.]

struct.name: Version
struct.note: The navigation mesh's format version. Every one of the 7,894 navigation meshes in Fallout4.esm is version 15.

struct.name: Pathing Cell
struct.note: The cell the mesh is in: the magic that marks it, the worldspace that holds it, and then either the grid it is in or the cell itself.

struct.name: Parent Worldspace
struct.note: The worldspace the cell is in, or zero when the cell is an interior one.

struct.name: Parent
struct.note: Where the cell is: the grid it is in when there is a worldspace, and the cell itself when there is not. [documented: xEdit wbDefinitionsFO4.pas (Mozilla Public License 1.1), wbNVNMParentDecider; measured: the two shapes are both four bytes.]

struct.name: Vertices
struct.note: The mesh's vertices, twelve bytes each: three floats. [measured: every one of the 7,894 navigation meshes in Fallout4.esm has a whole number of them.]

struct.name: Triangles
struct.note: The mesh's triangles, twenty-one bytes each: three vertex indices, three edge indices, a height, a byte of flags and the flags themselves. [measured: every one of the 7,894 navigation meshes in Fallout4.esm has a whole number of them.]

struct.name: Cover Flags
struct.note: The cover over each of the triangle's three edges, four bits each.

struct.name: Edge Links
struct.note: The mesh's edge links, eleven bytes each: four unknown bytes, the mesh they link to, the triangle they are on and one more byte. [measured: every one of the 7,894 navigation meshes in Fallout4.esm has a whole number of them.]

struct.name: Door Triangles
struct.note: The triangles a door is on: the triangle before the door, an unknown word, and the door's reference when the word is not zero. [documented: xEdit wbDefinitionsFO4.pas (Mozilla Public License 1.1), wbDoorTriangleDoorTriangleDecider; measured: the door's reference is there only when the unknown word is not zero, and every one of the 7,894 navigation meshes in Fallout4.esm fits.]

struct.name: Unknown 5
struct.note: Eight bytes each. [measured: every one of the 7,894 navigation meshes in Fallout4.esm has a whole number of them.]

struct.name: Unknown 6
struct.note: Four bytes each. [measured: every one of the 7,894 navigation meshes in Fallout4.esm has a whole number of them.]

struct.name: Waypoints
struct.note: The mesh's waypoints, eighteen bytes each: where the waypoint is, the triangle it is on, and an unknown word. [measured: every one of the 7,894 navigation meshes in Fallout4.esm has a whole number of them.]

struct.name: Navmesh Grid
struct.note: The grid the mesh is cut into: how wide it is, the distances across it, and then the cells. The grid is as wide as it is tall, so there are as many cells as its width squared, and each cell holds the triangles that fall in it. [measured: every one of the 7,894 navigation meshes in Fallout4.esm fits this shape, the grid's width being no more than twelve.]
